name: Camino Real de Tierra Adentro
description: The Royal Inland Road, or Silver Route, ran north from Mexico City toward New Mexico for roughly 2,600 km. The Mexican stretch listed here covers 1,400 km and includes 55 sites, from historic towns and bridges to haciendas, plus five other World Heritage sites. For three centuries, mule trains carried silver from the Zacatecas, Guanajuato and San Luis Potosí mines south, and mercury arrived from Europe.
